general.name: Disk Health - SMART Failure Detected [Mac] [Lin]
general.description: Reads SMART data on every physical disk and alerts on a failed self-assessment, failing attribute or threshold breach. Read-only. Linux needs smartmontools. https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components

variables.name: reallocMax
variables.description: Max reallocated sectors (ATA attribute 5); also the SCSI grown-defect-list cap.

variables.name: crcMax
variables.description: Max interface CRC errors (199). Usually a cable fault.

variables.name: tempMax
variables.description: Max drive temperature in C (attribute 194 or 190).

variables.name: failOnPastTrip
variables.description: true: alert on attributes that tripped In_the_past. false: report them only.

variables.name: failOnUnreadable
variables.description: true: alert when any one disk's SMART data cannot be read. false: report it only.

variables.name: smartctlTimeout
variables.description: Seconds allowed per smartctl call, where timeout(1) exists.
